prompts.text: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit the supplied female back fly exercise animation frame. Preserve exactly the 1024x768 canvas, rear three-quarter camera, woman identity, ponytail, black shirt, black shorts with orange seam, shoes, torso, legs, scale, head position and planted foot coordinates. Correct the arms to be extended nearly straight, raised approximately parallel to the floor, in a return phase of a standing resistance band reverse fly (between arms out and arms forward); no rowing bent elbows. Repair resistance bands as continuous thin dark strands from the handles toward a common off-canvas image-left stationary anchor, with no detached segments or extra dangling strands. Restore fragmented light shoe soles, retaining exact footwear size and ground anchors. Match original detailed fitness illustration style. Actual transparent alpha background, including all enclosed gaps; no white background, no painted checkerboard. No other changes, text, cropping, enlargement, post, or floor.

Edit target: original female exercise illustration. Precise localized repair only: reconnect the broken lower resistance band fragments into one continuous slender dark line ending behind the torso, matching existing line width; restore missing pixels in white shoe soles without enlarging the shoes or doubling outlines. Lock all other original pixels, arms pose, anatomy, clothes, camera, scale, placement and 4:3 canvas. For reliable background extraction put only the empty background and enclosed empty gaps on perfectly flat solid chroma green RGB(0,255,0). No green on subject. No checkerboard, white backdrop, gradients, shadows, or new objects. Preserve original thin bands and detailed fitness illustration texture. Do not extend band endpoints or redesign anything.

Precise exercise animation repair. Image 1 is the edit target female return phase; image 2 is the SAME woman in the correct intermediate straight-arm phase and is the exact anatomy/identity/equipment reference. Replace only image 1's bent-elbow upper body and broken bands with the straight-arm intermediate return position shown in image 2, matching that reference geometry exactly. Keep image 2's complete handle-to-band connections: both visible near-handle attachments and continuous thin strands, no broken or floating fragments. Preserve exact original texture, outfit, ponytail, proportions, lower body, planted shoes and 4:3 framing. Do not invent a new exercise or row. Background solid pure green #00ff00 for extraction, including enclosed gaps; no checkerboard or green subject. Result should be indistinguishable in style and figure scale from image 2. No text.
